QUOTE: "**Deny (`ServerManager::execute`).** Runs after approval, so a deny pattern blocks a call even when it was approved." and "`ServerManager::execute(name, args)` ... PermissionManager::is_denied(deny list) ──match──► "Permission denied" result └─ route_tool_call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in ServerManager::execute before routing, but frames approval (allow list/auto_approve/callback) as a separate gate that can also block ("otherwise Permission denied, call never runs"), so it does not conclude that the deny list is the only blocker.
